glyph_origin: Oracle bone script: • Shi group (thick strokes): Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 水 (“water”) + phonetic 何. • Variant: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 水 + phonetic 可 (phonetic drawn wavy like water; possibly original form of 歌, representing wavy sound). • Corruption: Confused with 何 (水 corrupted to 人; 可 corrupted to a shoulder burden, possibly original form of 柯. • He group: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): 水 + 何. • Huang group: Compound of 欠 / 旡, a shoulder burden, and 水. • Western Zhou bronze: Inherits Huang group structure; adds 口. • Possibly related to 何 (to bear).
senses: [hé] (by extension) river, especially a smaller river. See usage note.
